calls.title: Usim + GrowthBook
calls.summary: Christian Liebenow (GrowthBook) spoke with Muhammed Zaulifqar (fractional CPO at USIM, an eSIM app) about using GrowthBook for phased rollouts and experimentation to replace risky all-at-once releases, with a focus on non-technical self-service. Key pain points included the need for safe, targeted releases and easy A/B testing without heavy engineering involvement. Next steps: Christian will share a GenAI visual editor demo video and SDK docs; Muhammed will review and likely start a Pro trial.
